About the Wilson and Yinka Badejo Scholarship

The Wilson and Yinka Badejo Foundation Educational Assistance Programme offers scholarships every year to brilliant indigent students who are pursuing their dream of completing their higher education.

The Wilson and Yinka Badejo Scholarship have provided over 500+ scholarships to students from poor backgrounds since the inception of this programme in 2008.

The scholarship is targeted towards academically sound students planning to attend (or already attending) a public tertiary institution and students must fulfil all eligibility requirements before their application can be considered by the scholarship board of the Wilson & Yinka Badejo Foundation.

Benefits of Wilson and Yinka Badejo Scholarship

The Wilson and Yinka Badejo Scholarship awards a cash sum of ₦70,000 to every selected candidate as support towards the cost of their education in Nigerian universities, colleges, or polytechnics.

Participating Institutions of Wilson and Yinka Badejo Scholarship

Universities, polytechnics, and colleges of education are all eligible to apply for the Wilson and Yinka Badejo Scholarship.

Requirements for 2026 Wilson and Yinka Badejo Foundation Scholarship (WYBF)

To be eligible for the undergraduate Wilson and Yinka Badejo Foundation Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Demonstrated financial need: Applicants must come from a less privileged background, as evidenced by providing a short personal statement on background.

  • Academic & Personal excellence: Applicants must have a strong academic record and also possess demonstrated good character that can be readily verified.

  • Enrollment status: Applicants must be enrolled or accepted to an accredited public tertiary institution (Note: Students in private tertiary institutions are not eligible).

  • Previous beneficiaries: Individuals who have received at least two scholarships from our foundation in the past are not eligible to reapply to ensure fairness and equal opportunity.

  • Multiple Applications: Applicants may apply for both the Legacy and the Nurturing Hearts scholarships. However, if selected, the applicant can receive only one scholarship award.
